market_name: Wilmington, NC coastal visitor market (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: OBSERVATION box, not an admission boundary. It covers New Hanover County in full and deliberately reaches beyond it -- north to Hampstead, Topsail Island and Burgaw, west and south to Leland, Bolivia, Southport and Oak Island -- so that PTF-WILMINGTON-NC-NORMAL-PRODUCTION-001 classifies those properties on evidence instead of being blind to them. Admission is decided by the market contract's corridor registry over the property's OWN postal code, never by this box.
geographic_bounds._no_overlap_proof: No committed discovery box overlaps this one. Raleigh's box begins at 35.45 N, Charlotte's at 34.85 N and the Piedmont Triad's at 35.66 N; this box ends at 34.58 N.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~3 decimal places) approximate reference points. They are seed points for bounded-radius queries only; membership is decided by the corridor registry over the property's own postal code.
_boundary_note: PTF-WILMINGTON-NC-NORMAL-PRODUCTION-001. A coastal market: downtown, midtown, the ILM airport / Mayfaire north side, Wrightsville Beach and Carolina / Kure Beach are CORE; Monkey Junction, Ogden / Porters Neck and Leland are CORRIDOR; Castle Hayne is FRINGE. Hampstead, Topsail, Southport, Oak Island, Bald Head Island and Burgaw are OBSERVED and REFUSED.

explicit_hotel_admissions._what_this_is: The explicit-hotel mechanism, so a single legitimate fringe property never becomes a reason to widen a municipality or a postal code. Empty at authoring time.
